method: Every final image opened and inspected as actual pixels after GLB reimport. Official photos and A-C-C-C-B seating diagram inspected as pixels before modeling. No image-generation substitutes or postfiltered raster variants.
scope: Offline visual candidate and two bounded interior LODs; no runtime acceptance

views.observation: Final LOD0 at 1.57 m. Curved waterfall/lumbar seat surfaces and separate gray shell edges/open grips are visibly retained after the 12k-triangle optimization. Silver supports and door/window depth are legible; small facets are visible in reduced grips.

Final LOD0 at 1.65 m eye height. Blue shaped seats, staggered flex pads, yellow swept grab rails, white reveals, window seals and ceiling coves remain distinct. Passenger-facing safety text is correctly oriented. Neutral gray beyond glazing is the QA environment, not window-panel geometry.

Final LOD1 retains the body, rail/seat placement, main openings and continuous level floor at much lower cost. Seat grips, most supports, small mountings and fine trim are absent; seat/leaning-pad surfaces are visibly coarser. This is a distance optimization candidate, not a close-interior quality replacement.

Final LOD0 at 1.65 m, viewed from 0.665 m beyond the short connector to fit the portal/header and handrails in frame. The raised header, side walls and bridge plate frame an open view into the car. This is an inspection camera, not a validated passenger anchor in a second car; no second car is modeled.

limitations: Raw Cycles CPU images retain Monte Carlo grain; the installed Blender build has no denoiser. These are geometry/material inspection renders, not noise-free marketing images.
Exact vehicle dimensions, seat positions/facing and mounting details are representative; full five-car engineering and exterior compatibility are not established.
The high-detail master exceeds the runtime budget and is kept separate. The reduced LOD1 intentionally loses small physical details.
The front observation-salon region is modeled but was not given a dedicated final preview; no claim of a surveyed cockpit or exact seat-facing plan.
Doors are closed static geometry. No platform alignment, boarding, moving gangway or accessibility acceptance.
Actual operator divider artwork is deliberately omitted; no reference photographic pixels appear in delivered textures.
